notes.title: June 2024 Update
notes.content:
・English voices (synthetic voices) have been added. While we hope this improves accessibility for English-speaking users, this is still an experimental feature.
・Added a new scene.
・Fixed a few visual issues.
・Fixed minor text issues.

notes.title: Minor bug fix
notes.content: Fixed an issue of the system option.

notes.title: Traditional Chinese language support update!
notes.content:
We have just pushed up an update which adds support for Traditional Chinese language. We really hope you will enjoy this new feature.
As well we have fixed the following things:
- fixed an issue regarding the screenshot thumbnails which displayed a different image from the screenshot
- adjustment to the option menu interface
- fixed a display issue of the menu bar
- fixed a few minor visual issues

notes.title: Minor visual and text issues fix
notes.content: Fixed a few visual minor issues and a some typo for the English language.
